translations.① 结构正确 · Schema、类型、状态: ① Structural correctness · Schema, types, state
translations.② 行为正确 · 路由、工具、权限、副作用: ② Behavioral correctness · routing, tools, permissions, side effects
translations.③ 语义正确 · 事实与证据: ③ Semantic correctness · facts and evidence
translations.④ 推理正确 · 决策与权衡: ④ Reasoning correctness · decisions and tradeoffs
translations.5 类 Golden 场景、13 次真实运行；按层成对比较，任一硬约束回归即阻断: 5 Golden scenario types, 13 real runs; pairwise by layer; any hard-constraint regression blocks release.
translations.把必须成立的事实、路径、安全约束和容忍度从参考文字中拆出来。: Extract required facts, paths, safety constraints, and tolerances from the reference text.
translations.保存每次 Plan、Route、Tool、Evidence 与 Trace；不要: Retain every Plan, Route, Tool, Evidence, and Trace—not just averages.
translations.本书记号：k 次全部成功: Book notation: all k runs succeed
translations.表达可以不同，但事实不能自由改写；路径可以不同，但不变量必须成立。: Expression may vary, but facts cannot be freely rewritten; paths may vary, but invariants must hold.
translations.持续评测：从数据到发布，再从生产回到数据: Continuous evaluation: data → release → production → data
translations.端到端指标判断是否成功 · 分层指标定位哪里失败: End-to-end metrics show success · Layered metrics locate failure
translations.规则全量 · Judge 抽样 · 用户反馈 · 业务结果: Rules on all traffic · sampled Judge · user feedback · business outcomes
translations.候选搜索关心至少一次成功；生产路径更关心每一次都安全、都满足不变量。: Candidate search cares about at least one success; production paths require every run to be safe and satisfy invariants.
translations.跨租户泄露、未授权副作用、合同破坏：任何一次命中都应硬阻断。: Cross-tenant leakage, unauthorized side effects, or contract violations: any occurrence must block release.
translations.离线回归控制发布；线上观测发现真实分布、质量事件与漂移。: Offline regression controls releases; online observation reveals real distributions, quality incidents, and drift.
translations.满足安全不变量的运行比例: Share of runs satisfying safety invariants
translations.能由代码确定的属性交给规则；开放属性由校准后的 Judge 判断；争议和高风险进: Use rules where code can decide, a calibrated Judge for open-ended properties, and human review for disputes and high risk.
translations.评测对象：一条受约束的因果链: Evaluation target: a constrained causal chain
translations.确定性模式证明控制面稳定；它不冒充真实随机模型的分布评测。: Deterministic mode proves control-plane stability; it does not claim to evaluate a real stochastic model's distribution.
translations.四层正确性：从可解析到可决策: Four levels of correctness: from parseable to decision-ready
translations.同一 Golden Case · 固定 Fixture · 10 次运行: Same Golden Case · Fixed Fixture · 10 runs
translations.外层需要更多语义判断；内层失败时，外层高分不能抵扣。: Outer layers require more semantic judgment; high outer-layer scores cannot offset inner-layer failures.
translations.位置偏差 · 冗长偏差 · 自偏好 · Prompt Injection: Position bias · verbosity bias · self-preference · Prompt Injection
translations.质量事件 → 最小复现 Case → 人工复核 → 治理后进入 Golden D: Quality incident → minimal reproduction Case → human review → governed entry in Golden Dataset

translations.k 次中至少一次成功: At least one success in k runs
